tools.name: wordpress_health_check
tools.title: WordPress health check
tools.description: Confirm the WordPress REST API is reachable, authentication works, and the tour/pages/media endpoints are exposed. Never returns credentials. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: wordpress_list_tours
tools.title: List WordPress tours
tools.description: List tours from the public WordPress site (custom post type 'tour'). Returns concise summaries only — no full HTML content. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: wordpress_get_tour
tools.title: Get WordPress tour
tools.description: Fetch a single WordPress tour by ID including raw editable content (context=edit), taxonomies, ACF/meta fields where exposed, and a content analysis flagging YOOtheme/scripts/iframes. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: wordpress_find_tour
tools.title: Find WordPress tour
tools.description: Search the WordPress tour custom post type by free text (title/slug/content). Returns likely matches with IDs and public URLs. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: wordpress_list_pages
tools.title: List WordPress pages
tools.description: List standard WordPress pages. Concise summaries only. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: wordpress_get_page
tools.title: Get WordPress page
tools.description: Fetch a WordPress page by ID with raw and rendered content plus a content analysis flagging YOOtheme layouts and other builder markers. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: wordpress_get_media
tools.title: Get WordPress media item
tools.description: Fetch a WordPress media item by ID. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: wordpress_search_media
tools.title: Search WordPress media
tools.description: Search the WordPress media library. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: wordpress_get_taxonomies
tools.title: Get WordPress taxonomies
tools.description: Return WordPress standard categories, tags, and the custom 'tours' taxonomy terms with their IDs. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: wordpress_update_tour_fields
tools.title: Update WordPress tour ACF fields
tools.description: Update a safe subset of ACF fields on a WordPress tour: pricing (price, single_room_price, twin_room_per_person_price, double_room_per_person_price), payment_details, dates (start_date, end_date, time_frame), status, radio_book_now, add_download_brochure, attach_brochure_here (WordPress media attachment ID for the brochure PDF, or null to clear), location, capacity, and the repeaters inclusions / exclusions_details / faqs_list / add_review. Any other key is stripped. Admin/manager only; every call is written to wordpress_integration_audit_logs with a before/after ACF snapshot. Hotels 1-5 are NOT writable here — use wordpress_get_tour to inspect them. The itinerary repeater is handled by wordpress_preview_tour_itinerary / wordpress_push_tour_itinerary.

acf.description: Partial ACF payload. Only listed keys are accepted; unknown keys are stripped.

tools.name: wordpress_upload_media
tools.title: Upload a file to the WordPress media library
tools.description: Upload a PDF or image (JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF) into the connected WordPress site's media library and return the new attachment id + source_url. Max 20MB. Provide the file as base64 in `data_base64`. Typical use: uploading a brochure PDF, then passing the returned id into `wordpress_update_tour_fields` under `acf.attach_brochure_here` (and setting `acf.add_download_brochure` to enable the download button). Admin/manager only; every upload is written to wordpress_integration_audit_logs.

content_type.description: MIME type. Allowed: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif.

data_base64.description: Base64-encoded file contents (no data: prefix). Max 20MB after decoding.

title.description: Optional attachment title shown in WordPress. Defaults to the filename.

tools.name: wordpress_get_tour_itinerary
tools.title: Get WordPress tour itinerary
tools.description: Read the live itinerary currently published on a WordPress tour post. Returns the `itinerary` ACF repeater rows in order, each with its `date_event` heading and `details` HTML. Read-only, admin/manager only.

tour_id.description: The WordPress tour post id (not the ART tour uuid).

tools.name: wordpress_preview_tour_itinerary
tools.title: Preview itinerary push to website
tools.description: Dry run before publishing: renders the ART itinerary for a tour into WordPress repeater rows and diffs them row-by-row against what is live on the website. Changes nothing. Use this, show the diff to the user, then call `wordpress_push_tour_itinerary` to publish. Admin/manager only.

wordpress_tour_id.description: Override the WordPress tour post id. Defaults to the linked post for this tour.

tools.name: wordpress_push_tour_itinerary
tools.title: Push itinerary to website
tools.description: Publish the ART itinerary for a tour to its linked WordPress tour post, replacing the live `itinerary` repeater rows (this is what guests see on the website). ART is the source of truth; the push is one-way ART → WordPress. Run `wordpress_preview_tour_itinerary` first, show the diff, and only call this once the user has approved — you must pass confirm=true. Every call is written to the WordPress audit log with a before/after snapshot. Admin/manager only.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirms the user has reviewed the diff and approved publishing to the live website.

wordpress_tour_id.description: Override the WordPress tour post id. Defaults to the linked post for this tour.

tools.name: get_tour_messages
tools.title: Get tour messages
tools.description: Read the three tour comms messages used in email templates: the Welcome Message (with its on/off switch, heading, body and sign-off), the Pickup/Arrival Message, and the Welcome Drinks Message. Also returns the uploaded pickup/arrival document (e.g. an arrivals map) and its public URL. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: update_tour_messages
tools.title: Update tour messages
tools.description:
Edit the tour comms messages shown in the tour's Comms → Messages tab and pulled into email templates: the Welcome Message (turn on/off with `welcome_message_enabled`, plus heading/body/sign-off), the Pickup/Arrival Message and the Welcome Drinks Message. Message bodies are rich text — pass simple HTML (

, , ,

    , ). Only the fields you supply are changed. Admin/manager only.

welcome_message_enabled.description: Turn the tour's Welcome Message on (true) or off (false).

welcome_message_body.description: Welcome message body (rich text / simple HTML).

welcome_message_signoff.description: Welcome message sign-off, e.g. 'The ART Team'.

pickup_arrival_message.description: Pickup/Arrival message (rich text / simple HTML) — where and when guests are met. May hyperlink the uploaded pickup document.

welcome_drinks_message.description: Welcome Drinks message (rich text / simple HTML) — where guests first gather.

tools.name: upload_tour_pickup_document
tools.title: Upload tour pickup/arrival document
tools.description: Upload the tour's Pickup/Arrival document (e.g. an arrivals map PDF) and attach it to the tour. Provide the file as base64 in `data_base64`, max 20MB. Replaces any existing pickup document. Returns a public URL you can hyperlink from the Pickup/Arrival message (e.g. 'For further details, see map here.'). Set `insert_link_text` to append that hyperlink to the message automatically. Admin/manager only.

content_type.description: MIME type. Allowed: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, text/plain, text/csv, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/vnd.ms-powerpoint, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation

insert_link_text.description: Optional link text, e.g. 'see map here'. When supplied, a paragraph hyperlinking the document is appended to the Pickup/Arrival message.

tools.name: replace_tour_itinerary
tools.title: Replace the whole tour itinerary
tools.description: Replace a tour's current itinerary in one call: every existing day and entry is deleted and rebuilt from the `days` array (day numbers assigned in array order, entry sort order in array order). Destructive — always show the user the new itinerary and confirm before calling. Creates the itinerary if the tour has none. Admin/manager only.

entries.description: Entries for the day, in display order.

days.description: The complete new itinerary, ordered day 1 first.

title.description: Optional itinerary title (only applied when supplied).

tools.name: reorder_itinerary_days
tools.title: Reorder itinerary days
tools.description: Renumber the days of an itinerary. Provide `day_ids` in the order you want them shown — day_number is rewritten as 1,2,3… Every day of the itinerary must be listed. Dates are not changed. Admin/manager only.

day_ids.description: Itinerary day ids (uuid) in the desired order, first day first.

tools.name: reorder_itinerary_entries
tools.title: Reorder itinerary entries
tools.description: Set the display order of the entries within one itinerary day. Provide `entry_ids` in the order you want them shown — sort_order is rewritten as 0,1,2… Every entry of the day must be listed. Admin/manager only.

entry_ids.description: Entry ids (uuid) in the desired display order.

tools.name: list_tours
tools.title: List tours
tools.description: List tours the signed-in user can access. By default returns SOONEST start date first (ascending), which is what you want for questions about the 'next departing tour' — the FIRST row is the next tour to depart. To reliably answer 'next departing tour', set `upcoming_only: true` (excludes tours that already started) and read the first row. Returns up to 200 tours by default (raise `limit` up to 500). Optionally filter by name/location search term, status, or upcoming-only. Set `sort: 'desc'` for most-recent-first.

search.description: Case-insensitive match against tour name or location.

status.description: Filter by exact tour status. Valid values: pending, available, limited_availability, sold_out, closed, past, cancelled, archived. Omit to return tours of every status.

upcoming_only.description: When true, only return tours whose start_date is today or later (excludes past departures). Use this to find the next departing tour.

sort.description: Sort order by start_date. 'asc' (default) = soonest first (next departing at top); 'desc' = furthest future first.

limit.description: Maximum number of tours to return (default 200, max 500).

tools.name: get_next_departing_tour
tools.title: Get next departing tour
tools.description: Deterministically return the SINGLE next departing tour the signed-in user is authorised to see: the earliest tour whose start_date is on or after the as-of date. Use this instead of list_tours whenever you need the 'next', 'upcoming' or 'soonest' tour — do NOT infer it from the order of list_tours. If as_of_date is omitted, the organisation's current date (Australia/Sydney) is used. Excludes archived tours always, cancelled tours unless include_cancelled, and test tours unless include_test_tours. Read-only.

as_of_date.description: Optional as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today in Australia/Sydney.

include_test_tours.description: Include tours flagged as test tours. Default false.

tools.name: get_tour
tools.title: Get tour details
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single tour by its id, including dates, pricing, capacity and host.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings for a tour
tools.description: List bookings for a given tour id, including passenger counts, status and accommodation dates.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list bookings for.

status.description: Optional booking status filter (e.g. paid, deposited, waitlist).

limit.description: Maximum number of bookings to return (default 100, max 500).

tools.name: list_recent_bookings
tools.title: List recent bookings
tools.description: List bookings across all tours, filtered by created_at or updated_at date range. Use for questions like 'bookings in the last 7 days'. Defaults to last 7 days by created_at. Restricted to admin or manager.

days.description: Look back this many days from today (default 7). Ignored if start_date/end_date provided.

date_field.description: Which date column to filter on (default created_at).

status.description: Optional status filter (e.g. paid, deposited, waitlist, cancelled).

tools.name: list_tour_activities
tools.title: List tour activities
tools.description: List activities for a given tour id, including dates, times, locations, transport and dress code.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list activities for.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.title: Get activity details
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single activity, including pickup journeys and which bookings are attending.

tools.name: list_tour_hotels
tools.title: List tour hotels
tools.description: List hotels and hotel bookings for a given tour id, including check-in/out dates, bedding and allocated rooms.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list hotels for.

tools.name: get_tour_itinerary
tools.title: Get tour itinerary
tools.description: Fetch the day-by-day itinerary for a tour, including days and entries with times and descriptions.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to fetch the itinerary for.

tools.name: list_tour_passengers
tools.title: List tour passengers
tools.description: List all passengers on a tour with their names, contact details, dietary requirements, medical conditions and accessibility needs.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list passengers for.

tools.name: get_booking_passenger_details
tools.title: Get booking passenger details
tools.description: Fetch full passenger details for a single booking, including passport details, travel docs, waivers, hotel, activity bookings, dietary and medical info.

tools.name: list_tour_custom_forms
tools.title: List tour custom forms
tools.description: List custom forms attached to a tour, including their fields and submitted responses.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to list custom forms for.

tools.name: list_tour_additional_info
tools.title: List additional info sections
tools.description: List the Additional Information sections for a tour, in display order. Use the returned ids to edit or delete sections.

tools.name: list_email_rules
tools.title: List automated email rules
tools.description: List active automated email rules (email templates) and their ids. Use these ids in `include_in_email_rules` on an Additional Information section to make the section appear as an info block in those emails.

include_inactive.description: Include inactive rules too. Defaults to false (active only).

tools.name: create_tour
tools.title: Create tour
tools.description: Create a new tour. Requires name, start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), and the number of days and nights. Optional fields set location, host, capacity, status and pricing.

status.description: One of: pending, available, closed, sold_out, past, cancelled.

tools.name: update_tour
tools.title: Update tour
tools.description: Update fields on an existing tour by id. Only the fields you provide are changed. Useful for editing dates, pricing, status, notes and operations notes while building a tour.

status.description: One of: pending, available, closed, sold_out, past, cancelled.

dates_not_confirmed.description: True when the race date is still to be confirmed by the race club.

tools.name: create_itinerary
tools.title: Create tour itinerary
tools.description: Create the itinerary for a tour and auto-generate one day per date between the tour's start and end dates. Fails if an itinerary already exists for the tour.

tour_id.description: The tour id (uuid) to create the itinerary for.

tools.name: add_itinerary_day
tools.title: Add itinerary day
tools.description: Add a single day to an existing itinerary. Provide the itinerary_id and the activity_date (YYYY-MM-DD). The day number is assigned automatically as the next in sequence.

activity_date.description: The date for the new day, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: upsert_itinerary_entry
tools.title: Add or edit itinerary entry
tools.description: Add a new entry to an itinerary day, or edit an existing one. To add, provide day_id and subject. To edit, provide entry_id. content is optional.

entry_id.description: Existing entry id (uuid) to edit. Omit to create a new entry.

day_id.description: The itinerary day id (uuid). Required when creating.

tools.name: delete_itinerary_entry
tools.title: Delete itinerary entry
tools.description: Permanently delete a single itinerary entry by its id.

entry_id.description: The itinerary entry id (uuid) to delete.

tools.name: delete_itinerary_day
tools.title: Delete itinerary day
tools.description: Permanently delete an itinerary day and all of its entries by the day id.

day_id.description: The itinerary day id (uuid) to delete.

tools.name: add_additional_info_section
tools.title: Add additional info section
tools.description: Add an Additional Information section to a tour. Provide the tour_id, a name, and the content (HTML or plain text). icon_name defaults to 'Info'.

is_visible.description: Whether the section is shown, default true.

include_in_email_rules.description: Automated email rule ids this section should be injected into (as an info block). Use `list_email_rules` to find ids.

tools.name: update_additional_info_section
tools.title: Update additional info section
tools.description: Edit an existing Additional Information section by its id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

include_in_email_rules.description: Automated email rule ids this section should be injected into (as an info block). Replaces the existing list. Use `list_email_rules` to find ids.

tools.name: delete_additional_info_section
tools.title: Delete additional info section
tools.description: Permanently delete an Additional Information section by its id.

tools.name: list_booking_invoices
tools.title: List a booking's Xero invoices
tools.description: List all Xero invoices linked to an ART booking, with totals, payments received, outstanding balance, invoice statuses and the ART booking payment status. Uses the canonical mapping for linkage and live Xero data for current amounts (falls back to cached mapping data with a stale warning if Xero is unavailable). Restricted to admin/manager.

tools.name: get_xero_invoice
tools.title: Get a Xero invoice
tools.description: Fetch full LIVE detail for a single Xero invoice by invoice_id (Xero InvoiceID/GUID) or invoice_number: summary, line items, payments, contact and reference, plus the linked ART booking and its payment status. Restricted to admin/manager.

tools.name: get_booking_payment_summary
tools.title: Get a booking's payment summary
tools.description: Summarise a booking's financial position from its linked Xero invoices: total invoiced, total paid, total outstanding, current ART status and the expected status inferred from Xero payments (with a discrepancy flag). booking_contract_total is returned as null unless an authoritative stored total exists; a mismatch is never asserted without one. Restricted to admin/manager.

tools.name: list_outstanding_invoices
tools.title: List outstanding invoices
tools.description: List bookings with outstanding Xero balances (amount due > 0), optionally scoped to a tour. Returns booking, primary client, tour, invoice number, due date, total, amount paid, amount due and days overdue. Candidate invoices come from the canonical mapping cache; each is refreshed against live Xero for the current due date and amounts. Restricted to admin/manager.

tour_id.description: Optional tour id to scope results.

overdue_only.description: Only include invoices past their due date.

due_before.description: Only include invoices due before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_payment_exception_report
tools.title: Get payment exception report
tools.description: Compute the ART payment-exception report for a tour using the canonical classification rules (deposit/instalment/final-balance). Returns each exception booking with its primary and all applicable exception types, expected due date, expected amount with an explicit source label, and Xero monetary values (received/outstanding) labelled by source. This RE-COMPUTES the rules; it does not fetch a previously generated report artifact. Does NOT change any data. Restricted to admin/manager.

as_of_date.description: Optional as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

tools.name: compare_art_payment_report_to_xero
tools.title: Compare ART payment exceptions to Xero
tools.description: For the bookings in a tour's ART payment-exception report, compare the ART position to the live Xero position and surface discrepancies (e.g. ART outstanding but Xero paid, and vice versa) using conservative rules. Scope is TOUR/REPORT SCOPED — it does NOT perform organisation-wide orphan-invoice detection; XERO_INVOICE_NOT_LINKED_TO_BOOKING is only reported for invoices encountered within this scope. Duplicate links, stale cache and incomplete live verification are flagged and never treated as confirmed financial discrepancies. Does NOT change any data. Restricted to admin/manager.

report_type.description: Which exception category to compare (default all_payment_exceptions).

as_of_date.description: Optional as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

tools.name: explain_booking_payment_position
tools.title: Explain a booking's payment position
tools.description: Explain one booking's payment position: the ART classification (primary + all applicable exceptions with expected amounts and source labels), the live Xero position (active invoices only; voided/deleted excluded, credit notes respected), a conservative status comparison (only 'fully paid' when ALL active linked invoices have no amount due), duplicate-link findings, and informational date differences. Never asserts a discrepancy from stale cache alone or from aggregate-total comparisons. Does NOT change any data. Restricted to admin/manager.

as_of_date.description: Optional as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking overview
tools.description: Fetch a minimised, non-sensitive operational overview of one booking by id: status, dates, passenger count, room/bedding type, accommodation dates, linked customer ids and operational flags. Excludes all passport, medical, emergency-contact and dietary data. Read-only; access is RLS-scoped to the signed-in user.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer overview
tools.description: Fetch a minimised, non-sensitive customer/contact profile by id: name, email, phone, location and created date. Excludes all passport, medical, emergency-contact, accessibility and dietary data, and internal external-CRM identifiers (e.g. Keap). Read-only; access is RLS-scoped to the signed-in user.

tools.name: search_customers
tools.title: Search customers by name or email
tools.description: Find customers/contacts by a free-text query matching first name, last name, preferred name, full name or email (case-insensitive, partial match). Use this FIRST to resolve a person's name (e.g. 'Jason Reed') into a customer_id before calling get_customer or list_customer_bookings. Returns minimised non-sensitive fields (id, name, email, phone, location). Read-only; RLS-scoped to the signed-in user.

query.description: Name or email to search for, e.g. 'Jason Reed' or 'reed@'.

tools.name: list_customer_bookings
tools.title: List a customer's bookings
tools.description: List every booking a customer is linked to (as lead, secondary or passenger 2/3), with tour name, dates, status, passenger count, room/bedding type and a current/upcoming/past classification. Includes a financial-summary availability flag but no financial figures and no sensitive passenger data. Read-only; RLS-scoped to the signed-in user.

tools.name: list_invoice_mapping_issues
tools.title: List invoice mapping issues
tools.description: Audit bookings whose linked Xero invoice is unhealthy: the mapped invoice is DELETED or VOIDED in live Xero, or the mapped invoice number disagrees with the booking's invoice_reference field. Each mapping is refreshed against live Xero (falling back to the cached mapping with a stale_warning when Xero is unavailable). Optionally scope to a tour. Read-only; changes nothing. Restricted to admin/manager.

tour_id.description: Optional tour id to scope the audit.

issue_types.description: Which issue categories to include. Defaults to both.

tools.name: list_tour_attachments
tools.title: List tour attachments
tools.description: List all file attachments (guest docs, ops docs, etc.) uploaded against a tour.

tools.name: list_tour_external_links
tools.title: List tour external links
tools.description: List external links (docs, photos, videos, references) attached to a tour.

tools.name: list_tour_pickup_options
tools.title: List tour pickup options
tools.description: List configured pickup locations for a tour.

tools.name: list_tour_host_assignments
tools.title: List tour host assignments
tools.description: List staff/host users assigned to a tour.

tools.name: list_tour_document_images
tools.title: List tour document images
tools.description: List images uploaded against a tour's guest documents.

tools.name: list_tour_ops_reviews
tools.title: List tour ops reviews
tools.description: List operations review sign-offs recorded against a tour.

tools.name: list_tour_alerts
tools.title: List tour alerts
tools.description: List capacity, cancellation, unread-email and other alerts raised for a tour.

tools.name: list_tour_operations_documents
tools.title: List tour operations documents
tools.description: List operations documents attached to a tour along with their sections/content.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.title: Get hotel details
tools.description: Fetch a single hotel with all fields, hotel bookings, attachments and external links.

tools.name: list_activity_attachments
tools.title: List activity attachments
tools.description: List file attachments (contracts, briefs, tickets) uploaded against an activity.

tools.name: list_hotel_attachments
tools.title: List hotel attachments
tools.description: List file attachments (contracts, rooming confirmations) uploaded against a hotel.

tools.name: get_attachment_download_url
tools.title: Get a download link for a stored file
tools.description: Create a temporary signed download link for a file already stored in the private attachments bucket. Pass the `file_path` returned by any list_*_attachments / upload_* tool. Admin/manager only.

expires_in_seconds.description: Link lifetime in seconds (default 3600, max 604800 = 7 days).

tools.name: upload_tour_attachment
tools.title: Upload a file to a tour
tools.description: Upload a document or image against a tour (guest docs, contracts, ops paperwork). Provide the file as base64 in `data_base64`, max 20MB. Appears in the tour's Attachments section. Admin/manager only.

content_type.description: MIME type. Allowed: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, text/plain, text/csv, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/vnd.ms-powerpoint, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation

tools.name: upload_activity_attachment
tools.title: Upload a file to an activity
tools.description: Upload a document or image against an activity (contracts, briefs, tickets, dress code sheets). Provide the file as base64 in `data_base64`, max 20MB. Admin/manager only.

content_type.description: MIME type. Allowed: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, text/plain, text/csv, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/vnd.ms-powerpoint, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation

tools.name: upload_hotel_attachment
tools.title: Upload a file to a hotel
tools.description: Upload a document or image against a hotel (contracts, rooming confirmations, invoices). Provide the file as base64 in `data_base64`, max 20MB. Admin/manager only.

content_type.description: MIME type. Allowed: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, text/plain, text/csv, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/vnd.ms-powerpoint, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation

tools.name: upload_itinerary_document
tools.title: Upload the itinerary snapshot or guest document
tools.description: Upload (or replace) a tour's Itinerary Snapshot or Guest Document file on its itinerary. Choose `document` = 'itinerary_snapshot' or 'guest_document'. Any existing file for that slot is replaced and removed from storage. Provide the file as base64 in `data_base64`, max 20MB. Admin/manager only.

filename.description: Filename including extension, usually a PDF.

content_type.description: MIME type. Allowed: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, text/plain, text/csv, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/vnd.ms-powerpoint, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation

tools.name: upload_tour_document_image
tools.title: Upload a tour guest document image
tools.description: Upload an image used in a tour's guest documents (max 10 per tour), with an optional caption. Provide the file as base64 in `data_base64`, max 20MB. Admin/manager only.

content_type.description: MIME type. Allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif

caption.description: Optional caption shown under the image.

tools.name: list_activity_external_links
tools.title: List activity external links
tools.description: List external reference links attached to an activity.

tools.name: list_booking_travel_docs
tools.title: List booking travel documents
tools.description: List travel documents (passports, visas, etc.) recorded against a booking, including full passport numbers, DOB and nationality (admin/manager only).

tools.name: list_booking_waivers
tools.title: List booking waivers
tools.description: List signed / requested waivers for a booking or for all bookings on a tour.

tools.name: list_booking_comments
tools.title: List booking comments
tools.description: List internal staff comments on a booking.

tools.name: list_tour_email_logs
tools.title: List tour email logs
tools.description: List sent-email logs for a tour (subject, recipient, status, error, sent_at). Filter with booking_id or a limit.

tools.name: list_scheduled_emails
tools.title: List scheduled emails
tools.description: List emails scheduled for future delivery. Filter by tour_id or booking_id.

tools.name: list_pending_email_approvals
tools.title: List pending status-change email approvals
tools.description: List status-change email approvals currently awaiting review. Filter by tour_id.

tools.name: list_email_templates
tools.title: List email templates
tools.description: List all email templates (name, subject, body, category).

tools.name: list_tour_email_rule_overrides
tools.title: List tour-specific email rule overrides
tools.description: List automated-email rule overrides configured for a specific tour (custom templates, disabled rules, etc.).

tools.name: create_hotel
tools.title: Create hotel
tools.description: Add a new hotel to a tour.

tools.name: update_hotel
tools.title: Update hotel
tools.description: Update fields on an existing hotel by id. Only supplied fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_hotel
tools.title: Delete hotel
tools.description: Delete a hotel by id. This cascades to hotel bookings — confirm with the user first.

tools.name: upsert_hotel_booking
tools.title: Create or update a hotel booking
tools.description: Create a hotel booking (link a booking to a hotel with dates/bedding/room) or update it if hotel_booking_id is supplied.

hotel_booking_id.description: Provide to update; omit to create.

tools.name: delete_hotel_booking
tools.title: Delete a hotel booking
tools.description: Remove a hotel booking (unlink a booking from a hotel).

tools.name: create_activity
tools.title: Create activity
tools.description: Add a new activity to a tour.

tools.name: update_activity
tools.title: Update activity
tools.description: Update fields on an existing activity. Only supplied fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_activity
tools.title: Delete activity
tools.description: Delete an activity by id. Cascades to activity bookings — confirm first.

tools.name: upsert_activity_booking
tools.title: Create or update an activity booking
tools.description: Assign a booking to an activity with a passenger count, or update the count. Provide activity_booking_id to update, or activity_id + booking_id to create.

passengers_attending.description: Number of passengers attending (0 to opt out).

tools.name: delete_activity_booking
tools.title: Delete an activity booking
tools.description: Remove a booking's assignment to an activity.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks with optional filters. Filter by status, priority, category, tour_id, assignee_user_id, or search text in title/description. Returns up to `limit` (default 50, max 200) most recent tasks.

assignee_user_id.description: Filter tasks assigned to this user id.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring in title or description.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: Return full task detail: task row, assignments, watchers, approvers, subtasks, comments, entity links, and attachments metadata.

tools.name: list_task_statuses
tools.title: List task statuses
tools.description: List configured task status values (label, value, sort order, is_finished flag).

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a task. Optionally assign users via `assignee_user_ids` (creates task_assignments rows). Status enum: not_started|in_progress|waiting|completed|cancelled|archived|not_required|with_third_party|awaiting_further_information|approval_required|approved|changes_needed. Priority: low|medium|high|critical. Category: operations|finance|marketing|booking|maintenance|general. Due date accepts YYYY-MM-DD (stored as literal date) or full ISO timestamp.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: Update fields on an existing task. Only supplied fields are changed. Set status to 'completed' to complete a task.

quick_update.description: Short status note; timestamps set automatically.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.title: Delete task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task and its assignments/comments/subtasks (cascades). Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.title: Add task comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task. Optionally reply to another comment via parent_comment_id.

tools.name: assign_task
tools.title: Assign task
tools.description: Assign one or more users to a task (adds task_assignments rows; existing assignments unchanged).

tools.name: unassign_task
tools.title: Unassign task
tools.description: Remove a user's assignment from a task.

tools.name: add_task_subtask
tools.title: Add task subtask
tools.description: Add a subtask (checklist item) to a task.

tools.name: update_task_subtask
tools.title: Update task subtask
tools.description: Update a subtask. Set completed=true to mark it done (fills completed_at/by).

tools.name: delete_task_subtask
tools.title: Delete task subtask
tools.description: Delete a subtask from a task.

tools.name: list_itinerary_day_photos
tools.title: List itinerary day photos
tools.description: List the photos attached to a tour's itinerary days (max 3 per day). Returns each photo with its day number/date, caption, a temporary signed preview URL, and the WordPress media id once the photo has been synced to the website gallery (`wp_media_id` null = not yet on the website). Admin/manager only.

day_id.description: Optional: only return photos for this itinerary day id.

tools.name: upload_itinerary_day_photo
tools.title: Upload an itinerary day photo
tools.description: Upload a photo (JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF, base64 in `data_base64`, max 20MB) against one day of a tour's itinerary. Maximum 3 photos per day — delete one first with `delete_itinerary_day_photo` if the day is full. Photos live in the ART admin system; publish them to the website day gallery with `wordpress_sync_itinerary_day_photos`. Get day ids from `get_tour_itinerary`. Admin/manager only.

day_id.description: The itinerary day id (uuid) from get_tour_itinerary.

content_type.description: MIME type. Allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif

caption.description: Optional caption / alt text, also written to WordPress on sync.

tools.name: delete_itinerary_day_photo
tools.title: Delete an itinerary day photo
tools.description: Remove a photo from an itinerary day in the ART admin system (also deletes the stored file). The WordPress media library copy is left in place, but the photo drops out of the website day gallery the next time you run `wordpress_sync_itinerary_day_photos`. Must pass confirm=true. Admin/manager only.

photo_id.description: The itinerary day photo id (uuid) from list_itinerary_day_photos.

confirm.description: Must be true — confirms the user approved deleting this photo.

tools.name: wordpress_sync_itinerary_day_photos
tools.title: Publish itinerary day photos to the website
tools.description: Publish the photos attached to a tour's itinerary days (uploaded with `upload_itinerary_day_photo`) into the matching day galleries on the linked WordPress tour post. Any photo not yet in the WordPress media library is uploaded first, then each itinerary row's `gallery` is set to that day's photos in order (days with no ART photos keep whatever gallery is already live). ART is the source of truth and the sync is one-way ART → WordPress. Requires confirm=true; every call is audited with a before/after snapshot. Admin/manager only.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirms the user approved publishing these photos to the live website.

wordpress_tour_id.description: Override the WordPress tour post id. Defaults to the linked post for this tour.

tools.name: get_tour_inclusions
tools.title: Get tour inclusions & exclusions
tools.description: Read a tour's structured inclusion and exclusion items (in display order, with their ids) plus the tour's Website Description block. These are what publish to the WordPress tour page. Admin/manager only.

tools.name: update_tour_inclusions
tools.title: Replace tour inclusions or exclusions
tools.description: Replace the full inclusion OR exclusion list for a tour with the supplied items, in the order given. Each item is one bullet on the website; light inline HTML (<b>, <i>, <a href>) is kept, block markup is stripped. This replaces the existing list for that kind — read it with `get_tour_inclusions` first. Nothing is published to the website until `wordpress_push_tour_inclusions` is called. Admin/manager only.

items.description: The full list of items, in display order.

tools.name: reorder_tour_inclusions
tools.title: Reorder tour inclusions or exclusions
tools.description: Set the display order of a tour's inclusion or exclusion items by listing their ids in the desired order (ids come from `get_tour_inclusions`). Admin/manager only.

item_ids.description: Item ids in the desired display order.

tools.name: update_tour_website_description
tools.title: Update tour website description
tools.description: Set the tour's Website Description block — the HTML that publishes to the Tour Details section of the WordPress tour page (intro copy, notes and the inclusions copy shown there). Nothing goes live until `wordpress_push_tour_inclusions` is called. Admin/manager only.

website_description.description: HTML for the Tour Details description block.

tools.name: wordpress_preview_tour_inclusions
tools.title: Preview inclusions push to website
tools.description: Dry run before publishing inclusions/exclusions/description: diffs the ART lists and Website Description against what is live on the linked WordPress tour page. Changes nothing. Show the diff to the user, then call `wordpress_push_tour_inclusions` with confirm=true. Admin/manager only.

wordpress_tour_id.description: Override the WordPress tour post id.

tools.name: wordpress_push_tour_inclusions
tools.title: Push inclusions to website
tools.description: Publish a tour's inclusion/exclusion lists and Website Description to its linked WordPress tour page, replacing the live `inclusions` / `exclusions_details` repeaters and the Tour Details content. ART is the source of truth; the push is one-way ART → WordPress. Run `wordpress_preview_tour_inclusions` first, show the diff, and only call this once the user approves — confirm=true is required. Empty ART lists are never pushed (it will not blank the website). Admin/manager only.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirms the user reviewed the diff and approved publishing.

sections.description: Which sections to publish. Defaults to all three.

wordpress_tour_id.description: Override the WordPress tour post id.

tools.name: wordpress_pull_tour_inclusions
tools.title: Import inclusions from website
tools.description: One-time import: reads the live WordPress tour page's inclusions, exclusions and Tour Details description and copies them into ART for that tour. Call without confirm to preview what would be imported; call with confirm=true to write (this REPLACES the tour's ART lists). Admin/manager only.

confirm.description: true to write the imported content into ART. Omit to preview.

wordpress_tour_id.description: Override the WordPress tour post id.
